official_documentation_checked.api: AudioSystem local File and InputStream overloads
official_documentation_checked.finding: The getAudioFileFormat and getAudioInputStream overloads consume local files or streams and return parsed audio properties.
Java SE documents a WAVE file type.
Its format, frame length and sample bytes are observable after AudioSystem opens the WAV file.

limit: Two verified public API paths share the same OpenJDK Java Sound WAVE reader family. They are runtime entries, not third-party ranked packages. Verification compiles the adapter with no Maven or external classpath and runs it on OpenJDK 25.
